text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That was a magnificent run, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've grown stronger again. So strong 
that no one can reach you...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Maya was supposed to win! Maya 
can beat Brian-san, she can!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya will... definitely win next time...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What are you, a kid?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... 'Cause I'm gonna win...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, just keep chasing after me. 
Keep your eyes on my back."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll compete against you as many times as 
it takes. I'll always be right here in the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Maya won't lose! 'Cause I'm gonna 
get suuuper strong!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
......Heh. You're right, maybe I should 
just be that honest with myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll win too, Brian. One day, I will beat 
you. Even if I can't reach you right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Brian. This is the strength you 
possess.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Commanding the entire venue with almost 
violent intensity, she captivates the 
hearts of those who watch, reshaping them 
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Some may have felt their hearts shifting 
into resignation. However, the truth is—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was captivated. Convinced that 
this running style was truly the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A run so fierce that you wish nobody else, 
but you yourself could take it down.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It is truly a strength that utterly 
captivates every Umamusume who lives for 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Enough to make even me want to be selfish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...So this year is over too, huh.
choice_data_list: You really did great out there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: As if I would.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I get thirsty thinking about next year. A 
new generation arrives, racing again—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I'm really looking forward to it.
